To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we introduce a neural network model for learning a predictive model of event sequences from narrative text and that we find that recent work in learning vector-space embeddings for words can be effectively applied in this domain, providing a good initialization for the neural network model.

(1) we have introduced a new development of narrative cloze evaluation, (2) we have shown that simple vector-space models for events can provide a good initial representation for learning a neural network model of event sequences, and (3) our model of event sequences is competitive with existing methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatically learning event sequences from text.
the automatic acquisition of knowledge about the temporal ordering of narrative events.
the problem of automatically learning event sequences, with the aim to use them as input to a narrative generation system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of our experiments show that our model is effective in capturing the coherence of a sequence of events, and is a promising approach to learning a model of narrative coherence from text.
our model outperforms the other models, but we do not have the space to go into details here.

the model is able to learn event representations that capture the semantic meaning of the events and the strength of association of the events, and is able to use these to make predictions about the events that will follow in a sequence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to learn a predictive model for event prediction using a neural network model.
we have developed a novel neural network model that can learn to predict events from the text, and we have introduced a new development of narrative cloze evaluation.
our model is capable of learning event representations from text and using them for predicting the next event in a story, which is an important step towards building a narrative generation system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neural network model can be used to acquire a rich model of events and their coherence from text.

a simple model can learn to predict event sequences from text with a good level of accuracy, and that a more expressive, neural network model can learn to compose event representations and predict event sequences even more accurately.
a simple model of events as vectors, with a simple composition function and a simple coherence function, can be learned to predict event sequences in narrative text.
